grade: proved structural parametrization and finite census specification; exact core-state polynomial formula; no census executed

scope.trees: ordinary finite trees admitting a vertex cover of size at most six
scope.claim: complete six-cover core plus at most five outside connector vertices and six pendant-leaf multiplicities

proof_facts: Pad any cover of size below six to size six because n>6.
The outside of a vertex cover is independent, so every outside vertex not of degree one is a connector adjacent only to cover vertices.
Deleting outside degree-one vertices leaves a connected tree containing the cover.
With t connectors and L outside leaves, n=6+t+L and n-1=e_C+sum_D deg(u)+L, hence e_C+sum_D(deg(u)-1)=5.
Each connector contributes at least one to the budget, so t<=5.
Conversely, each connected core tree satisfying the stated connector and budget constraints, with the prescribed pendant leaves, is a tree with the designated six-cover.

census_recipe.connector_neighborhoods: subsets of the six cover labels of size at least two, in lexicographic multiset order
census_recipe.core_filter: connected; budget fixes core edge count to 5+t, so retained core is a tree
census_recipe.multiplicity_domain: all weak compositions of n-6-t into six nonnegative parts

polynomial_formula: P_T(z)=sum_{I independent in K} z^|I| product_{c in C\N_K[I]}(1+z)^m_c
selector_requirements: Reconstruct original leaves from full graph degrees, including cover vertices of degree one.
Compute x from zero-extended independence counts through terminal descent.
Use the same fixed original-leaf selector Delta_p(T-v)<0 and include every favorable leaf tag separately.
limitations: This does not prove a pointwise third-shell sign or the complete primary aggregate.
No low-cover skeleton and multiplicity census was executed.
No theorem for trees with cover number at least seven is established here.
The 64-state formula supplies exact evaluation but no sign inequality.
